title: LEZ
description:
It's time to feel the rhythm through notes and hit them with rhythm!

LEZ is a rhythm game in the style of osu!mania with 6 keys. It's an indie game made by only one person in July 2020 with the goal to make a creative rhythm game with an unique design. 

• A streamer mode for content creators (and also youtubers), we really care about them :D 

• A lot of songs by professional and well know artists. 

• Integration with Logitech G Hub to feel the music through the RGB 

• Do you feel the beatmaps very hard or very easy? There's mods that you can use to increase/decrease the difficulty
